sloka: क्रुद्धमाज्ञाय रामं तं वसिष्ठ: प्रत्युवाच ह ।जाबालिरपि जानीते लोकस्यास्य गतागतिम् ॥ २.११०.१॥
transliteration: kruddhamājñāya rāmaṁ taṁ vasiṣṭha: pratyuvāca ha ।jābālirapi jānīte lokasyāsya gatāgatim ॥ 2.110.1॥

translations.english: Seeing Rama angry Vasistha intercedes, saying that Jabali is wellaware of the exits and entrances of humans on earth.
